summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting a one-month extension of its business combination deadline until June 22, 2026, funded by a $50,000 deposit into the trust account, half from working capital and half from target WISeSat.Space Corp. pursuant to the November 9, 2025 Business Combination Agreement. The SPAC can extend monthly until January 22, 2027 by depositing $50,000 per month. A $25,000 unsecured promissory note was issued to the target for its share of the extension fee. This is a routine SPAC extension filing; watch for shareholder redemptions and risk-arb implications tied to the pending de-SPAC merger.
